fullPassage: Hobbies Are Modern Activities Nowadays, everybody has a hobby they like to do in their free time. In the past, though, this probably wasn’t true because most people had to work long hours in agriculture or manufacturing, so free time must have been hard to come by. However, the Industrial Revolution and the labor movement that followed it led to a gradual decrease in working hours to eight-hour work days and five-day work weeks. For the first time in history, a majority of people had free time to enjoy activities that they found meaningful outside of work: hobbies. Hobbies Are Serious For many people, hobbies are serious. Serious leisure may sound like a contradiction, but that’s what it takes for an activity to qualify as a hobby. To take a hobby seriously, you have to make a meaningful effort to improve your skills, take risks, overcome hardships, or become a better version of yourself. If you meet someone who has woken up at the crack of dawn to take a picture at the “magic hour,” you can assume that they think of themselves as a “photographer.” A runner, a gamer, or a photographer are titles that people are proud to call themselves. On the other hand, you wouldn’t call yourself a “TV watcher” or “online surfer.” Watching TV and surfing online aren’t considered serious hobbies because there’s no challenge or way to improve yourself. Hobbies Create Community J. R. R. Tolkien, the author of The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings, was passionate about language. He invented languages with grammar rules and histories: Sindarin and Quenya, the former inspired by Welsh, and the latter inspired by Finnish and Latin. But inventing languages was a frustrating hobby because he had to isolate himself while creating them. He wrote of the isolation that he and other people who loved languages experienced: “But they become shy, ashamed of spending the valuable commodity of time for their private pleasure, and higher developments are locked in secret places.” Things are very different now. The Internet allows people to learn about languages and meet other language enthusiasts from all over the world. Instead of working on their projects in private, they can easily find other like-minded people to share their passion, celebrate their achievements, and encourage each other along the way. They could even work together on language projects that Tolkien may have never been able to imagine. Hobbies Are Gratifying While some people pursue a hobby to improve their skills, some do for the sheer pleasure of doing it. Albert Einstein started learning to sail when he was 18 years old, venturing out on the lakes in Switzerland and simply enjoying the time on his boat. He continued to enjoy sailing as a life-long sailor. Although he is considered a genius in physics, he wasn’t a good sailor, nor did he care about his sailing technique. His technique remained at a basic level, which was simply to “Set sail, make it fast, no thoughts of energy or speed, lean back, let the boat drift.” On a boat, he forgot everything else in the world, which may explain why he enjoyed sailing so much. For him, it was being out on the water that mattered the most. Einstein used the hobby of sailing to go to a place where he could be completely relaxed. Maybe that’s why he named his boat Tinef, meaning “worthless” in Yiddish, after the apparent meaninglessness of his sailing adventures. Watching the waves while on his boat, Einstein forgot all his worries. Like Einstein, for many people, hobbies just provide the conditions for a sense of pure satisfaction. Hobbies Can Contribute You may be surprised to find that pursuing a hobby can accomplish more than self-satisfaction. That is, it sometimes leads to an unexpected contribution to society. For example, Thomas Bopp, a manager at a construction materials factory and an amateur astronomer, discovered the comet Hale-Bopp while observing the sky with his friends in the Arizona desert. To make the story even more shocking, he was using a borrowed telescope that his friend had assembled himself. And Bopp is not alone. Numerous amateur astronomers have discovered comets, stars, and supernovas, which helps us to better understand the solar system and the universe. Amateurs in many other fields have made important contributions through their hobbies, such as amateur programmers developing new technologies, amateur writers publishing their work in local magazines, amateur history researchers preserving historical sites ... The list goes on and on! There are many reasons why people pursue hobbies. For many people, the challenge of learning a new skill or achieving a difficult goal is their primary motivation. Other people enjoy hobbies for the communities they can become a part of or the friendships they can make there. Still others enjoy hobbies because they can lose track of time and be in the moment, similar to being in a meditative state. Some people even end up making contributions to society through their hobbies, oftentimes unexpectedly. It is the physical, mental, or emotional experience, or even a combination of them, that makes a hobby rewarding and fun. Perhaps it should be called “pleisure.”

진지한 여가는 모순처럼 들리지만 어떤 활동이 취미가 되려면 필요한 것이다.

questions.passage: Tolkien, the author of The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings, was passionate about language.  He invented languages with grammar rules and histories: Sindarin and Quenya, the former inspired by Welsh, and the latter inspired by Finnish and Latin.  But inventing languages was a frustrating hobby because he had to isolate himself while creating them.  He wrote of the isolation that he and other people who loved languages experienced: “But they become shy, ashamed of spending the valuable commodity of time for their private pleasure, and higher developments are locked in secret places. ” Things are very different now.  The Internet allows people to learn about languages and meet other language enthusiasts from all over the world.  Instead of working on their projects in private, they can easily find other like-minded people to share their passion, celebrate their achievements, and encourage each other along the way.  They could even work together on language projects that Tolkien may have never been able to imagine.  Hobbies Are Gratifying While some people pursue a hobby to improve their skills, some do for the sheer pleasure of doing it.  Albert Einstein started learning to sail when he was 18 years old, venturing out on the lakes in Switzerland and simply enjoying the time on his boat.  He continued to enjoy sailing as a life-long sailor.  Although he is considered a genius in physics, he wasn’t a good sailor, nor did he care about his sailing technique.  His technique remained at a basic level, which was simply to “Set sail, make it fast, no thoughts of energy or speed, lean back, let the boat drift. ” On a boat, he forgot everything else in the world, which may explain why he enjoyed sailing so much.  For him, it was being out on the water that mattered the most.  Einstein used the hobby of sailing to go to a place where he could be completely relaxed.  Maybe that’s why he named his boat Tinef, meaning “worthless” in Yiddish, after the apparent meaninglessness of his sailing adventures.  Watching the waves while on his boat, Einstein forgot all his worries.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: Tolkien과 아인슈타인에 관한 세부 정보.
det.analysis:
① 웨일스어에서 영감을 받은 것은 Quenya가 아니라 Sindarin이에요('the former inspired by Welsh'에서 the former=Sindarin). 따라서 불일치
② 본문 'Albert Einstein started learning to sail when he was 18 years old, venturing out on the lakes in Switzerland'와 일치 ← 정답
③ 배 이름 Tinef는 '귀중한'이 아니라 '쓸모없는(worthless)'이라는 뜻이므로 불일치
④ 톨킨이 아니라 '지금(now)' 사람들이 인터넷으로 협업할 수 있다는 내용이고, 톨킨은 오히려 고립되어 작업했으므로 불일치
det.tip: Sindarin↔Quenya, worthless↔귀중한, 톨킨↔지금 사람들을 정확히 구분하세요.

ch: Tolkien은 웨일스어에서 영감을 받아 Quenya라는 언어를 만들었다.
아인슈타인은 18세에 스위스의 호수에서 항해를 배우기 시작했다.
아인슈타인은 자신의 배에 '귀중한'이라는 뜻의 이름을 붙였다.
Tolkien은 인터넷 덕분에 다른 언어 애호가들과 쉽게 협업할 수 있었다.

questions.passage: Nowadays, everybody has a hobby they like to do in their free time. In the past, though, most people ①<u>had</u> to work long hours in agriculture or manufacturing, so free time was hard to come by. However, the Industrial Revolution and the labor movement that followed it ②<u>led</u> to a gradual decrease in working hours. For the first time in history, a majority of people had free time to ③<u>enjoying</u> activities that they ④<u>found</u> meaningful outside of work.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ enjoying → enjoy: to부정사이므로 to 뒤에는 동사원형 enjoy
det.analysis:
✅ ① had: 'most people had to work long hours'에서 '~해야 했다'를 뜻하는 had to로 과거 시제라 적절
✅ ② led: 'the labor movement ~ led to a gradual decrease'에서 과거 시제 정동사로 적절
❌ ③ enjoying → enjoy: 'free time to ___ activities'는 '~할 자유 시간'이라는 뜻의 to부정사예요. to 뒤에는 반드시 동사원형을 써야 하므로 enjoying이 아니라 enjoy가 맞아요 ← 정답
✅ ④ found: 'activities that they found meaningful'에서 관계사절 안의 과거 시제 동사로 적절
det.tip: to + 동사원형: to enjoy(즐길). to 뒤에 -ing 금지

questions.passage: Tolkien, the author of The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings, was passionate about language.  He invented languages with grammar rules and histories: Sindarin and Quenya, the former inspired by Welsh, and the latter inspired by Finnish and Latin.  But inventing languages was a frustrating hobby because he had to isolate himself while creating them.  He wrote of the isolation that he and other people who loved languages experienced: “But they become shy, ashamed of spending the valuable commodity of time for their private pleasure, and higher developments are locked in secret places.
questions.stem: 위 글에 따르면, Tolkien이 만든 두 언어 중 웨일스어(Welsh)에서 영감을 받은 언어의 이름을 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 웨일스어에서 영감받은 언어.
det.analysis: 본문 'He invented languages ~ Sindarin and Quenya, the former inspired by Welsh, and the latter inspired by Finnish and Latin.'에서 the former(앞의 것)=Sindarin이 웨일스어(Welsh)에서 영감을 받았고, the latter(뒤의 것)=Quenya가 핀란드어·라틴어에서 영감을 받았다.
det.tip: the former=먼저 언급된 Sindarin, inspired by Welsh(웨일스어에서 영감)

questions.stem: 위 글에 따르면, 아인슈타인이 자신의 배에 붙인 이름을 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 아인슈타인의 배 이름.
det.analysis: 본문 'that's why he named his boat Tinef, meaning worthless in Yiddish'에서 그는 자신의 배를 이디시어로 '쓸모없는'을 뜻하는 Tinef라고 이름 붙였다. 항해가 별 의미 없어 보였기 때문이다.
det.tip: named his boat Tinef(배를 Tinef라 불렀다)에서 Tinef를 찾습니다.

questions.passage: You may be surprised to find that pursuing a hobby can accomplish more than self-satisfaction. That is, it sometimes leads to an unexpected __________ (contribute) to society.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 흐름에 맞도록 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.korean: contribution (기여, 공헌).
det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'it sometimes leads to an unexpected ___ to society'에서 관사 an과 형용사 unexpected(뜻밖의) 뒤에 오고, 앞에 전치사 to가 있으므로 명사 자리다. 동사 contribute(기여하다)를 명사 contribution(기여)으로 바꿔야 한다.
det.tip: an + 형용사 + ___ : 관사·형용사 뒤 명사 자리 → contribute를 contribution으로

questions.passage: Hobbies Are Modern Activities Nowadays, everybody has a hobby they like to do in their free time.  In the past, though, this probably wasn’t true because most people had to work long hours in agriculture or manufacturing, so free time must have been hard to come by.  However, the Industrial Revolution and the labor movement that followed it led to a gradual decrease in working hours to eight-hour work days and five-day work weeks.  For the first time in history, a majority of people had free time to enjoy activities that they found meaningful outside of work: hobbies.  Hobbies Are Serious For many people, hobbies are serious.  Serious leisure may sound like a contradiction, but that’s what it takes for an activity to qualify as a hobby.  To take a hobby seriously, you have to make a meaningful effort to improve your skills, take risks, overcome hardships, or become a better version of yourself.  If you meet someone who has woken up at the crack of dawn to take a picture at the “magic hour,” you can assume that they think of themselves as a “photographer.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글 전체를 아우르는 중심 소재.
det.analysis:
① 산업혁명은 취미가 생겨난 배경으로 잠깐 언급될 뿐 글의 중심이 아니에요.
② 취미가 진지함·공동체·만족감·사회 기여 등 여러 의미를 지니고 사람들에게 가치를 준다는 것이 글 전체의 주제 ← 정답
③ 톨킨·아인슈타인·Bopp는 취미의 의미를 보여 주는 예시일 뿐, 그들의 업적 자체가 주제가 아니에요.
④ 인터넷은 취미가 공동체를 만든다는 한 부분의 예일 뿐이에요.
det.tip: 다섯 개의 소제목(현대·진지함·공동체·만족·기여)을 모두 아우르는 것이 주제입니다.

ch: 산업혁명이 근로자의 노동 시간에 미친 경제적 영향
취미가 지니는 다양한 의미와 그것이 사람들에게 주는 가치
유명한 과학자와 작가들이 남긴 위대한 과학적 업적
인터넷이 외국어 학습 방식에 가져온 혁신적인 변화

In the past, though, this probably wasn’t true because most people had to work long hours in agriculture or manufacturing, so free time must have been hard to come by.  However, the Industrial Revolution and the labor movement that followed it led to a gradual decrease in working hours to eight-hour work days and five-day work weeks. questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글쓴이가 전하려는 핵심 메시지.
det.analysis:
① 사회 기여는 취미의 여러 가치 중 하나일 뿐, '반드시 기여해야만' 가치 있다는 것은 지나친 해석이에요.
② 진지함은 취미의 한 측면일 뿐, 그것만이 진정한 취미라는 것은 글 전체 요지가 아니에요.
③ 여가 시간의 양이 취미의 질을 결정한다는 내용은 본문에 없어요.
④ 본문 마지막 'It is the physical, mental, or emotional experience ~ that makes a hobby rewarding and fun'처럼, 취미가 다양한 방식으로 삶을 보람 있고 풍요롭게 한다는 것이 핵심 ← 정답
det.tip: 글 끝부분에서 취미가 주는 다양한 가치를 종합한 것이 요지입니다.

ch: 취미는 반드시 사회에 기여할 때에만 그 가치를 인정받는다.
진지하게 몰두하는 취미만이 진정한 취미로 인정받을 수 있다.
여가 시간이 많을수록 더 훌륭한 취미를 가질 수 있다.
취미는 실력 향상, 공동체, 몰입, 사회 기여 등 다양한 방식으로 삶을 풍요롭게 한다.

questions.passage: Amateurs in many other fields have made important contributions through their hobbies, such as amateur programmers developing new technologies, amateur writers publishing their work in local magazines, amateur history researchers preserving historical sites ...  The list goes on and on!  __________.  For many people, the challenge of learning a new skill or achieving a difficult goal is their primary motivation.  Other people enjoy hobbies for the communities they can become a part of or the friendships they can make there.
questions.stem:
위 글의 내용을 바탕으로, 다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오. (영어로)

'사람들이 취미를 추구하는 데에는 많은 이유가 있다.'

[조건]
(1) are, hobbies, many, people, pursue, reasons, there, why를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: There are many reasons why people pursue hobbies
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- '~이 있다'는 There are로 시작해요: There + are.
- 무엇이 있는가 하면 '많은 이유'예요: many + reasons.
- '~하는 이유'는 관계부사 why로 이어요. why 뒤에는 '주어+동사'가 와요: why + people + pursue + hobbies(사람들이 취미를 추구하는).
- 순서대로 놓으면 There / are / many / reasons / why / people / pursue / hobbies.
det.tip: There are + 명사 + why + 주어 + 동사: ~하는 많은 이유가 있다

questions.wa: There are many reasons why people pursue hobbies
accept: There are many reasons why people pursue hobbies
